CustomField.description: For cases created by email-to-case; if an email is received to a "stale" case (closed and older than a specified period), a new case will be created. This prevents old cases from reopening inappropriately. The new case will be referenced in this section.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: If populated, a new email-to-case record has been created at this record.
CustomField.label: Superseded By Case
